custom.description: I want to show when fracking actually loses its climate advantage over coal. Gas emits less CO₂ at the power plant, but raw methane is a massive short-term warming driver. My exhibit uses an interactive model to map out the 2.7% methane leak threshold where natural gas equals coal's climate footprint, stacking it against actual field data from major US basins.
custom.title: Coal VS Fracking
